Hi Jamie + Priya,

Thanks again for the time last week — attaching the draft customer spotlight we discussed (file: Atlantech_case_draft_v3.docx). This version focuses on the deployment story and the performance/cost outcomes your team shared. A few quick asks so we can move to publication: 

- Can you confirm the throughput and cost figures? In the draft we say “inference throughput improved by 2x” and “unit token cost dropped ~42%” — please flag any corrections.
- The pull-quote attributed to Jamie is currently: 
  "Redwood helped us cut inference costs by 42% while preserving throughput during peak shifts."
  Please let me know if you'd prefer different wording or attribution.
- I’ve anonymized customer counts, but if Legal needs different phrasing for the customer roster line, flag that.

If possible, could you return redlines or a quick note by end of day Thursday (11/26)? Priya, I also cc’d Stephanie from our marketing team in case editorial/legal coordination is useful. I’ve added a Google Drive link for collaborative review: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3AtlantechDraft

Attachments: [Atlantech_case_draft_v3.docx]

Thanks — excited to get this live.

Best,

From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@atlantech.com>

Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: Atlantech customer spotlight — technical assertions & quote signoff

Thanks, Olga — attached are our markups (redlines_ATL_20261125.pdf). Overall great draft; a few substantive items from our engineering and legal reviewers: 

1) Throughput claim: our internal benchmark shows ~1.8x median throughput improvement on our mixed-traffic workload, not 2x. Please update to 1.8x (or say "~1.8x") to be precise.
2) Cost reduction: the 42% number is correct for average token unit math across Q3, but we ask you to specify the period — e.g., "Q3 2026" — to avoid confusion.
3) Competitive reference: please remove the named competitor in paragraph 3; that language could create friction for procurement.
4) Quote tweak: happy to shorten the quote to "Redwood reduced our inference costs by 42% during Q3 2026." If Redwood prefers the longer phrasing about throughput, please mirror the numeric change above (1.8x).

Legal will follow up separately on the customer count/roster sentence; they may request an alternate phrasing. I'll loop Legal Reviewer (legal@atlantech.com) and expect a quick passback tomorrow.

Attached: redlines_ATL_20261125.pdf

Best,
Priya Singh
Director, Infrastructure 
Atlantech Logistics
priya.singh@atlantech.com

- Stephanie: can you update the copy to use "~1.8x" and add the parenthetical "(Q3 2026)" after the cost reduction figure? Also remove the competitor mention in para 3.
- Ben: can you confirm the throughput language and whether we can cite Atlantech's mixed-traffic benchmark methodology in a short footnote? Priya is okay with a short technical footnote but wants accuracy. If you can draft a one-sentence footnote we can share with Priya and Legal.

I’ve attached both the draft doc and their pdf redlines. Once we have your edits I’ll circulate back to Jamie/Priya and Legal Reviewer for final signoff. Timeline: they prefer publication the week of Dec 6 if possible.

Thanks for the forward, Olga — reviewed Priya's notes and made two concrete suggestions below. I updated the Drive draft and added a short technical footnote (file saved in Drive as: Atlantech_case_draft_v3_final_edits.docx). Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3AtlantechDraft

Edits proposed: 
- Throughput language: change to "median inference throughput improved by ~1.8x on Atlantech's mixed-traffic workload" (this mirrors Priya's ask and keeps it conservative).
- Cost figure: change to "unit token cost decreased by 42% (Q3 2026)".

Proposed final quote (two options). Recommend offering both to the customer and letting them pick: 
A) "Redwood reduced our inference costs by 42% during Q3 2026."
B) "Redwood helped us cut inference costs by 42% while improving median inference throughput by ~1.8x."

Technical footnote (one sentence): "Throughput is measured as median end-to-end inference requests per second across a representative mixed-traffic workload collected over a two-week period in September 2026; measurement excludes warmup runs."

Next steps: Olga — if you can send the two quote options and the updated draft to Priya + Jamie with a note that Legal is cc'd, we should be able to get a final signoff early next week. I will also prepare a cleaned PDF for approval once they pick a quote.
